title: Georgia businessman jailed for 15 years for $76m Ponzi scheme targeting 300+ investors
summary_full: Edwin Brant Frost IV, a businessman from Georgia, has received a 15-year prison sentence following his involvement in a Ponzi scheme that deceived more than 300 investors. This fraudulent operation caused a staggering loss of $76 million. Presenting himself as a reliable lender, Frost was actually battling significant financial turmoil. He misappropriated investors' money for his lavish lifestyle and political donations while neglecting loan repayments.
